title: Optional Follow-On Decision Matrix

options.name: Certified DL-026 Pedagogical Uplift
options.description: Add one choice-specific distractor explanation per affected Certified item. Each item has exactly one empty ExplanationWrong slot at a non-CorrectChoice position. No answer keys, stems, choices, or certification states change.
options.evidence_required: Per-item distractor analysis — what misconception does the empty slot's distractor target?
options.evidence_found: Each item's empty slot maps to a specific distractor choice text. The distractor content is present in the pack file — only the ExplanationWrong field is empty.
options.risk_detail: Write operations on 3 pack files (A, C, D). Backup-before-write required (BACKUP_PROTOCOL.md). Governance guard Rule 5: ≤28 items per batch. 13 items = 1 batch. No DL-008 regression risk (all CC slots already empty).
options.estimated_effort: ~30 minutes. 13 distractor explanations to author. 3 pack file backups. Post-write scan for DL-008/DL-026 regression.
options.lane_conflict_100_series: None — 700-series pack file writes don't intersect May files.
options.lane_conflict_500_series: None — 700-series pack file writes don't intersect case-bank files.
options.expected_deliverables: Updated pack_a/c/d_corrected.js with 13 new ExplanationWrong fields. REVISION_HISTORY.md entry. Post-remediation DL-026 scan confirming count reduced from 13 to 0.
options.recommendation: RECOMMENDED if user wants to keep 700-series lane active. Quickest win — closes the last open Certified defect category.

options.name: DL-031 / DL-032 Difficulty Recalibration

scope.dl031_items: ~500 MCQ items (definition-match pattern labeled Moderate, should be Easy)
scope.dl032_items: 420 case items (all labeled Moderate, zero variance)

options.description: Recalibrate difficulty metadata. DL-031: definition-match MCQs whose stems are textbook definitions with high lexical overlap to the correct answer. DL-032: case-bank items with uniform 'Moderate' labels.
options.evidence_required: Per-item cognitive level assessment. Comparison of stem-CorrectChoice lexical overlap. Bloom's level vs. difficulty label mapping.
options.evidence_found: Session 700 Layer 2 Difficulty Specialist confirmed systematic inflation. 6 of 7 sampled Moderate items were actually Easy. CAQS §6.1 target distribution vs. actual: significant gap.
options.risk_detail: Metadata-only changes (Difficulty, DifficultyScore). No answer keys, stems, choices, or explanations change. DL-032 touches scored_cases files — potential 500-series lane conflict if case-bank session is active.
options.estimated_effort: ~4-6 hours. ~500 MCQ items + 420 case items. Per-item verification recommended (not all Moderate items are inflated).
options.lane_conflict_500_series: HIGH if DL-032 targets scored_cases files concurrently with active case-bank repair session. Recommend DL-031 only (MCQ packs) or coordinate DL-032 timing with 500-series lane.
options.expected_deliverables: Updated Difficulty/DifficultyScore fields across ~920 items. Difficulty distribution report vs. CAQS §6.1 targets. REVISION_HISTORY.md entry.
options.recommendation: Defer. High effort, medium risk. Split into DL-031-only (MCQ packs) to avoid 500-series conflict. Full DL-032 should wait for 500-series lane to complete.

options.name: Non-Certified DL-026 Preparation
options.description: Add missing distractor explanations to non-Certified DL-026 items. These items are outside the learner pool and must be fixed before future certification.
options.evidence_required: Per-item distractor analysis. Priority ordering: which sections are closest to certification readiness?
options.evidence_found: 299 non-Certified items across Packs C/D Sections E and F. All Unprocessed — no certification urgency. Relevant only once these sections enter the certification pipeline.
options.risk_detail: Write operations on 2 pack files. No learner-pool impact — all items are Unprocessed/Archived. Batch protocol required.
options.estimated_effort: ~10-15 hours. 299 items × 1-2 empty slots each. Could be phased across multiple sessions.
options.expected_deliverables: Updated pack_c/c_d_corrected.js with distractor explanations. DL-026 scan confirming non-Certified count reduced.
options.recommendation: Lowest priority. No learner-pool impact. Only needed before certification of Pack C/D Sections E and F. Defer indefinitely.

options.name: Pause 700-Series Lane — Prioritize 100-Series or 500-Series
options.description: Freeze 700-series work. Direct effort to active 100-series May lane (calibration, tutoring, onboarding) or 500-series case-bank lane (repair, uplift, certification).
options.evidence_required: None — this is a prioritization decision.
options.evidence_found: 700-series certification state is stable. 2,181 Certified items are learner-ready. 13 Certified DL-026 items are a minor quality gap. 100-series and 500-series lanes have active work.
options.risk_detail: No 700-series risk from pausing. 13 DL-026 items remain as minor quality gap — no regression occurs from inaction.
options.recommendation: REASONABLE. The 700-series certification state is frozen and stable. Pausing allows focus on active 100-series May calibration/tutoring or 500-series case-bank repair.

recommended_next_700_series_action: S710 (Certified DL-026 Uplift) if user wants to close the last Certified defect gap. Otherwise, PAUSE 700-series and prioritize 100-series May or 500-series case-bank lanes.
alternate_recommendation: If user wants a quick S710 followed by lane pause: run S710 (~30 min) to close the 13-item gap, then freeze 700-series indefinitely.
